title: Three reticles and a fire-control HUD for the gunship, per-gun zoom, the owner's 40 mm report and the Rotor's own muffled firing sound from its optic, impacts that land seconds after the report, and the 105's paint-then-guide flow; FX package base 8
context: Owner's brief 2026-09-14: from the Rotor's PoV add the supplied HeavyMachineGun_RotorGunPOVSound.mp3 only while it fires, muffled, over the spin-up and spin-down, separating the rotors turning from the barrels firing; in the gunship PoV three reticles to tell the selected weapon apart, more HUD (distance, contacts, planet coordinates, calibres), each gun its own zoom, the rotary closer with lots of impact feedback and rotor-like sounds slightly deeper, the 40 mm with the supplied GunshipWeapon2Blast.mp3 and small area explosions that decimate groups, the 105 keeping the strike's sounds and effects but starting from the seat with its own reticle as a one-two: paint a red laser area, then launch and guide as the current strike does; fire 1 and 2 with a lag between the report at the gunship and the impact on the ground.
outcome: Audio: assets/audio/rotor_pov_fire.mp3 and gunship_bofors_fire.mp3 pinned in docs/gunship-audio.lock.json and checked by scripts/assets.mjs; src/audio.js voices accept a lowpass option (a BiquadFilter between source and gain); rotor_pov_fire loops at 0.9 gain through a 1400 Hz low-pass only while the piloted Rotor has fired within 0.35 s (td-tab, beside the spool loop) and stops with the seat; the gunship's rotary plays minigun_fire at pitch 0.8 from the ship and kinetic_fire at 0.9 where every second round lands; the Bofors plays the owner's report from the ship and blast_fire at 0.7 where the shell lands. Adding sound keys required the FX package base to move to stalheart-fx-8 (src/content/preset.js: an additive migration gives a version 7 package the two sounds at the baseline and keeps any it already carries; the shipped package promoted as gunship-and-rotor-optic-sounds through npm run presets -- promote). HUD: src/fx/gunship-hud.js draws the rotary's ring of ticks with a spinner that turns while the barrels fire, the Bofors' brackets with a red marker while a shell is in the air, the 105's diamond over a long cross with FIRE TO PAINT then TARGET PAINTED · FIRE TO LAUNCH, and a readout (gun, range, impact coordinates as a survey grid N/S E/W from the aim's unit vector, contacts, nearest from base, in blast, station, fire state, magnification). Zoom per gun: rotary 2.6x, Bofors 1.9x, heavy 1.3x. Impacts: every rotary round lands a small ring and a seven-dot burst, the Bofors an amber ring at 1.6 blast radii, a white core and a 44-dot burst, through host hooks burst/laser/falling folded into the pilot host; the 105's first press paints the aimed cell and lays the strike's red range ring, the second launches, the pointer lock is released and the seat yields the camera and the pointer to the strike's own fall cam and taps (pose returns false while the strike is falling), then the seat comes back. td-tab holds 17558 lines.
alternatives: Adding the two sound keys without a base bump: rejected, validatePreset requires every key in every package, so stored packages would have failed to load.
A deeper rotary sample for the gunship: not now, minigun_fire at 0.8 rate reads as the same family a register down.
evidence: npm test 103 programs (test/presets.mjs asserts the version 8 migration); npm run check (the gunship audio lock verified); npm run build; browser-test --gunship eight scenarios pass with the rotary and strike reticles asserted; browser-test --sentry-pilot passes with the Rotor's fire loop wired.
artifacts/browser/gunship-pov-rotary.png and gunship-pov-heavy.png: the two reticles and the HUD readout; the Rotor's PoV sound is not audible in a headless run and awaits the owner's ear.
